mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days when consistently observed.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 3.5% (UNRATE) signals labor market tightening that accelerates consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months with UNRATE < 3.5% (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0% creates inflationary pressure that triggers equity selling, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances meeting the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% rising for 3 months) reduce liquidity and increase discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of months meeting the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100.5 (INDPRO > 100.5) signals robust manufacturing output that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances with INDPRO > 100.5 (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1600 thousand units (HOUST > 1600.0) indicates strong consumer confidence and construction activity, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of months with HOUST > 1600.0 (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS > 100 and UNRATE < 4.0% signals labor market tightness that accelerates wage growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances meeting the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales volume exceeding 600,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 600000) signals strong housing market activity that correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of months with RSAFS > 600000 (t-test p > 0.05).
